card.name: Telling providers about meds or conditions
card.fires_on: The word "of" (or similar words like "disclose", "all", "history") right after instructions to inform or notify a healthcare provider. It fires where the next words list what to report, such as medications, surgeries or conditions.

modes.label: Inform/notify ... of
modes.description: The word "of" after "inform" or "notify" plus a provider or physician, before the thing to be reported.
modes.example: Advise patients to inform their healthcare provider<< of>> all concomitant products prior to and

modes.label: Disclose or report words
modes.description: Other words in the same instruction, such as "disclose", "all" or "history", just before what is to be reported.
modes.example: Patients should be counseled to<< disclose>> all medical conditions, including use of all

card.writes: It nudges the model toward words about medication and flags, so the next words name what should be reported.
card.plain: It lights up in patient advice telling people to tell their doctor about all their medicines, surgeries or conditions.
